query: Please implement a real-time communication website based on WebSocket, allowing users to establish connections, send and receive real-time messages. The website should have functionalities for establishing connections, sending messages, receiving messages, and disconnecting. Users should be able to log in, establish real-time communication with other users, send text, images, and other types of messages, and receive messages sent by other users. Set the background color to baby blue and the component color to navy.
